entities.name: DL Information Transfer Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to transfer NAS dedicated information or F1-C related information to the UE.

entities.name: DLInformationTransfer Message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate the DL information transfer procedure.

entities.name: NAS Dedicated Information
entities.description: Non-Access Stratum dedicated information that can be transferred using the DL information transfer procedure.

entities.name: F1-C Related Information
entities.description: F1 Control Plane related information that can be transferred using the DL information transfer procedure.

relations.description: The DL information transfer procedure is initiated by sending the DLInformationTransfer message.
The DL information transfer procedure can transfer NAS dedicated information.
The DL information transfer procedure can transfer F1-C related information.
